accepted.quote: Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members
accepted.summary: Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members

accepted.quote: a Majority of each shall constitute a Quorum to do Business
accepted.summary: A majority of each House constitutes a quorum to do business

accepted.quote: a smaller Number may adjourn from day to day
accepted.summary: A smaller number may adjourn from day to day
accepted.applies_to: a smaller Number may adjourn from day to day

accepted.quote: may be authorized to compel the Attendance of absent Members
accepted.summary: A smaller number may be authorized to compel attendance of absent members
accepted.applies_to: a smaller Number may adjourn from day to day

accepted.quote: in such Manner, and under such Penalties as each House may provide
accepted.summary: In such manner and under such penalties as each House may provide
accepted.applies_to: a smaller Number may adjourn from day to day

accepted.quote: Each House may determine the Rules of its Proceedings
accepted.summary: Each House may determine the rules of its proceedings

accepted.quote: punish its Members for disorderly Behaviour
accepted.summary: Each House may punish its members for disorderly behavior

accepted.quote: with the Concurrence of two thirds
Each House shall keep a Journal of its Proceedings
accepted.summary: Each House must keep a journal of its proceedings

accepted.quote: and from time to time publish the same
accepted.summary: Each House must publish its journal from time to time

accepted.quote: excepting such Parts as may in their Judgment require Secrecy
accepted.summary: Parts of the journal that require secrecy are exempt from publication

accepted.quote: the Yeas and Nays of the Members of either House on any question shall, at the Desire of one fifth of those Present, be entered on the Journal
accepted.summary: Yeas and nays of members on any question must be entered on the journal if desired by one-fifth of those present

accepted.quote: Neither House, during the Session of Congress, shall, without the Consent of the other, adjourn for more than three days
accepted.summary: Neither House may adjourn for more than three days without the consent of the other House

accepted.quote: without the Consent of the other
accepted.summary: Consent of the other House is required for adjournment
accepted.applies_to: Neither House, during the Session of Congress, shall, without the Consent of the other, adjourn for more than three days

accepted.quote: nor to any other Place than that in which the two Houses shall be sitting
accepted.summary: Neither House may adjourn to any other place than where the two Houses are sitting
